curation.name: Flat-Out Sprint
curation.summary: Microduck Academy perpetual walk-slot policy trained to sprint at maximum speed (~0.35 m/s) with fast driving strides while staying balanced.
curation.details: Published with a schema-v2 manifest carrying Academy lineage (prompt, judge_score 1.0, VLM pass). The Academy judge verdict is publisher-provided evidence, not registry verification; model_api, hw_rev, control_hz, servos and action_scale are not declared in the manifest.
curation.notes: The package manifest is resolved and inspected; several manifest fields are undeclared so installation needs review. The registry records no independent hardware evidence.

publisher_hardware.note: The publisher reports simulation judge evaluation only and no physical MicroDuck deployment evidence.
